description: Compatibility manifest of happy-platform-mcp Node baseline 6.2.0 (plan §7.1). The Rust replatform must preserve every entry unless the owner records a deviation. Machine-checked by scripts/compat/check-manifest.mjs; every entry carries `source` file:line from the Node tree.

cli.usage:
Usage:
  happy-platform-mcp instance add
  happy-platform-mcp instance list
  happy-platform-mcp instance update <name> [metadata flags; auth changes require remove/re-add]
  happy-platform-mcp instance test <name>
  happy-platform-mcp instance remove <name>
  happy-platform-mcp instance credential set <name> --type password|client-secret
  happy-platform-mcp instance migrate

dispatchOrder.rule: any argv token that looks like a secret flag/assignment, or a --type value other than password|client-secret => stderr SECRET_ARGUMENT_ERROR, exit 2
argv empty, or exactly ["--docs-only"] => stdio server (main()); exit 0 when stdin closes
argv[0] === "instance" => runInstanceCli (rest of argv ignored by this dispatcher)
argv[0] in --help|-h|help => usage on stdout, exit 0 (extra args ignored)
anything else => stderr "Unknown command. Use --help for usage.", exit 2
a rejected dispatch promise => stderr error message, exit 1

docsOnlyFlag.note: --docs-only is accepted ONLY as the sole argument and is a NO-OP: it starts the same stdio server, which is docs-only only via HAPPY_MCP_DOCS_ONLY or the credential-missing fallback

cli.bareInstance: argv ["instance"] or --help/-h/help after it prints USAGE on stdout, exit 0

extraFlags.flag: --type password|client-secret (only flag; masked prompt supplies the secret)

cli.flagSyntax: flags are --name value or --name=value; --default/--no-default may be bare booleans; unknown option => USAGE error (exit 2); update accepts the same METADATA_FLAGS

secretArgument.message: Secret flags and values are not accepted in command arguments; use a masked prompt.
secretArgument.rule: token starting with "-" whose name (strip leading dashes, remove -/_, lowercase) is password or clientsecret; OR token "<name>=<v>" with such a name; OR any --type/type= token anywhere in argv whose value is not password|client-secret

exitCodes.trigger: success; usage/help; stdio server ended by stdin EOF; `instance list` (incl. empty); `instance migrate` nothing to migrate; user-cancelled interactive command

instance CLI runtime error (registry/keychain/validation, instance not found); `instance test` auth/authorization/network failure; stdio startup failure; uncaught exception (process-guards); cli.js dispatch rejection

secret argument; unknown top-level command; USAGE errors (unknown instance subcommand, bad option, wrong arg count); NON_INTERACTIVE_PROMPT (add/credential set without a TTY); MIGRATION_SOURCE_EQUALS_TARGET / MIGRATION_SOURCE_IDENTITY_FAILED
server.js: startup refusal (missing/invalid HAPPY_MCP_API_TOKEN or allow-lists) exit 1; SIGTERM/SIGINT graceful exit 0. Not a package bin (`npm start`, package.json main)

exitCodeProbes.contains: Secret flags and values are not accepted
Secret flags and values are not accepted
Unknown instance command. Use --help for usage.
instance list does not accept options.
instance credential set requires an instance name.
Non-interactive use requires an interactive TTY
No legacy plaintext credentials require migration.

cli.exitCodeProbesNote: Run by the checker in a child process: cwd = empty temp dir (no .env), HOME and HAPPY_CONFIG_PATH point into that temp dir, stdin closed, no network, keychain never reached.

tools.hashing: inputSchemaSha256 = sha256(JSON.stringify(sortKeysRecursively(tool.inputSchema))); descriptionSha256 = sha256(tool.description). Tools are compared against the source registration order; the fixture file is name-sorted so it is compared by name. Schemas include the per-tool `instance` property added by addInstanceParameter (mcp-server-consolidated.js:65).
tools.docsOnlyList: docs-only tools/list = [SN-Register-Instance, SN-Docs-Families, SN-Docs-Status, SN-Docs-Sync, SN-Docs-Search, SN-Docs-Get] (no `instance` parameter injection) src/mcp-server-consolidated.js:208-211

protocol.capabilitiesNote: prompts is advertised but NO prompts handler is registered: prompts/list => JSON-RPC -32601

resources.name: ServiceNow Instance Info
resources.description: Information about the connected ServiceNow instance

resources.name: All ServiceNow Tables
resources.description: Complete list of available ServiceNow tables with metadata

resourceReads.behaviour: JSON {server_info{name "Happy MCP Server (Consolidated)", version}, instance_info{url: process.env.SERVICENOW_INSTANCE_URL, username: process.env.SERVICENOW_USERNAME} (undefined => omitted when the registry/keychain config is used), capabilities{total_tables, operations, tools: count from tools/list}}
JSON of the loaded table metadata

protocol.requestMethodsNote: initialize and ping are SDK-provided; tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, resources/read are registered here. No completion/logging/subscribe/prompts handlers; no notifications other than notifications/progress (sent when a tools/call carries _meta.progressToken).

script-sync.js is imported but never called (dead write path)

logging.stdio: all diagnostics via console.error (stderr); stdout is the MCP stream
logging.http: server.js uses console.log (stdout) for startup banner, DEBUG, shutdown; errors via console.error
logging.cli: instance CLI: results on stdout, errors/usage on stderr

environment.name: DEBUG
environment.purpose: 'true' logs the active instance at HTTP startup (stdout)

environment.name: HAPPY_CONFIG_PATH
environment.purpose: Explicit instance-registry path (trimmed, ~ expanded, path.resolve); read path = write path

environment.name: HAPPY_DOCS_CACHE_DIR
environment.purpose: Docs cache directory (files/ tree + index.sqlite); falls back to registry-file .docs.cacheDir

environment.name: HAPPY_DOCS_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
environment.purpose: Docs embedding provider name

environment.name: HAPPY_DOCS_ENABLE_LOCAL_INDEX
environment.purpose: true|1|yes enables the local FTS index (env presence overrides registry .docs.localIndexEnabled)

environment.name: HAPPY_DOCS_ENABLE_VECTOR
environment.purpose: true|1|yes enables vector search (env presence overrides registry .docs.enableVector)

environment.name: HAPPY_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environment.purpose: Comma list of allowed Host header values for HTTP

environment.name: HAPPY_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environment.purpose: Comma list of allowed Origin values for HTTP

environment.name: HAPPY_MCP_API_TOKEN
environment.purpose: Bearer token for the HTTP transport; 64 hex chars or 43 base64url chars; HTTP refuses to start without it

environment.name: HAPPY_MCP_BIND_HOST
environment.purpose: HTTP listen host

environment.name: HAPPY_MCP_DOCS_ONLY
environment.purpose: true|1|yes (case-insensitive) forces docs-only; 'false' disables the credential-missing docs-only fallback

environment.name: HAPPY_MCP_TELEMETRY
environment.purpose: on|1|true|yes enables anonymous opt-in usage pings (tool name counts)

environment.name: HAPPY_MCP_TELEMETRY_URL
environment.purpose: Overrides the telemetry endpoint

environment.name: PORT
environment.purpose: HTTP listen port

environment.name: SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE
environment.purpose: 'oauth' switches the .env-fallback instance to OAuth

environment.name: SERVICENOW_CLIENT_ID
environment.purpose: .env-fallback OAuth client id (only when SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE=oauth)

environment.name: SERVICENOW_CLIENT_SECRET
environment.purpose: .env-fallback OAuth client secret (only when SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE=oauth)

environment.name: SERVICENOW_INSTANCE
environment.purpose: Name of the registry instance to use at stdio startup (getInstanceOrDefault)

environment.name: SERVICENOW_INSTANCE_URL
environment.purpose: .env-fallback instance URL; also reported by resource servicenow://instance; also decides docs-only fallback

environment.name: SERVICENOW_OAUTH_AUTHORIZE_URL
environment.purpose: .env-fallback authorize endpoint (authorization_code only)

environment.name: SERVICENOW_OAUTH_CALLBACK_PATH
environment.purpose: .env-fallback loopback callback path (authorization_code only)

environment.name: SERVICENOW_OAUTH_GRANT_TYPE
environment.purpose: client_credentials | authorization_code selects a passwordless grant (.env fallback; also stdio fallback decision)

environment.name: SERVICENOW_OAUTH_REDIRECT_PORT
environment.purpose: .env-fallback loopback redirect port, decimal integer 0-65535, throws otherwise (authorization_code only)

environment.name: SERVICENOW_OAUTH_SCOPE
environment.purpose: .env-fallback OAuth scope (only when SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE=oauth)

environment.name: SERVICENOW_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL
environment.purpose: .env-fallback token endpoint (authorization_code only)

environment.name: SERVICENOW_OAUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
environment.purpose: Comma-separated exact https origins an OAuth authorize/token endpoint may use besides the instance origin; malformed entry throws

environment.name: SERVICENOW_PASSWORD
environment.purpose: .env-fallback basic-auth password (plaintext in env)

environment.name: SERVICENOW_TOKEN_STORE
environment.purpose: Refresh-token store selector: 'keychain' | 'file'; anything else throws

environment.name: SERVICENOW_USERNAME
environment.purpose: .env-fallback basic-auth username; also reported by resource servicenow://instance

environment.name: SSE_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL
environment.purpose: HTTP SSE keep-alive interval (ms)

environment.name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME
environment.purpose: Base directory of the FILE token store only (not used by config-path.js)

environment.name: HOME / USERPROFILE
environment.purpose: os.homedir(): default registry (~/.config/happy-platform-mcp/instances.json), docs cache (~/.happy-platform-mcp/...) and file-token-store (~/.config/happy-platform-mcp) roots

environment.name: process.cwd() and ./.env
environment.purpose: stdio-server.js and server.js call dotenv.config() (no override of already-set vars) so a .env in the working directory is read; cli.js `instance ...` subcommands never load .env; ./scripts is the fix-script output directory

environment.name: os.userInfo().username
environment.purpose: Part of the identity-v1 refresh-token tuple (OS user name)

stdio.entry: happy-platform-mcp / servicenow-mcp-server with no args (src/cli.js -> src/stdio-server.js main) or `node src/stdio-server.js`
selection: HAPPY_MCP_DOCS_ONLY in {true,1,yes} => docs-only; config manager NOT consulted (stdio-server.js:47-49,88-90)

on error: docs-only iff message matches /Missing ServiceNow credentials|servicenow-instances\.json not found/i AND HAPPY_MCP_DOCS_ONLY != "false" AND no env credentials (stdio-server.js:55-59); otherwise rethrow => exit 1
stdio.startupFailure: console.error("Failed to start Happy MCP Server:", error); process.exit(1)

stdioMatrix.case: missing credentials, no env creds => docs-only fallback
registry file not found message => docs-only fallback
unrecognised DOCS_ONLY value does not block fallback
URL + username only (no password, no passwordless grant) => still falls back

docsOnly.behaviour: initialize still advertises tools+resources+prompts; resources/list returns the same 2 resources; every other tool call => isError "Error: Tool <name> is unavailable in docs-only mode"

http.entry: `npm start` => src/server.js (package.json main); NOT a package bin
http.auth: bearer HAPPY_MCP_API_TOKEN required; startup refused (exit 1) when absent/invalid

precedence: 1. HAPPY_CONFIG_PATH (trimmed; ~, ~/ expanded; path.resolve): read = write, source "explicit"
2. ~/.config/happy-platform-mcp/instances.json if it exists: read = write, source "user"
3. <package>/config/servicenow-instances.json (legacy; NOT src/config) if it exists: read legacy, WRITE user path, source "legacy"
4. otherwise user path (read = write; file absent)

envFallback.rule: .env/environment instance (name "default", description "Loaded from .env", default:true) is used ONLY when the registry file does not exist (hasFile false / ENOENT / REGISTRY_FILE_NOT_FOUND); an existing registry file hides env credentials entirely

config.registryDocsProperties: the registry file may carry a top-level `docs` object (cacheDir, localIndexEnabled, enableVector, embeddingProvider) read by src/docs/config.js:12-23; env overrides it
config.legacyPlaintext: plaintext passwords in the registry => LEGACY_MIGRATION_REQUIRED on mutations; `instance migrate` moves them to the keychain
config.registryWrite: mkdir -p dir mode 0700; temp file ".<base>.<pid>.<Date.now>.<rand>.<attempt>.tmp" opened wx mode 0600; rename onto target

keychain.backend: @napi-rs/keyring Entry(service, account), lazily imported; a missing/locked backend surfaces KeychainUnavailableError (instance creds) or the raw error (refresh tokens)

healthCheck.procedure: set probe value, get, compare, delete; run on a missing credential to distinguish "absent" from "backend unavailable"

refreshToken.tupleSource: 'happy-platform-mcp/oauth-refresh-token', 1, osUser, instanceUrl, instance.clientId, new URL(endpoints.authorizeUrl).href, new URL(endpoints.tokenUrl).href
tupleOrder: canonical instance URL = URL.origin + pathname with trailing "/" trimmed (no query/fragment; host lowercased, default port dropped by WHATWG URL)
refreshToken.serialization: JSON.stringify of a 7-element array (no spaces, default escaping), hashed as UTF-8 with SHA-256, lower-case hex

testVectors.case: uppercase host + default port normalised by URL

refreshToken.legacyAccountFormat: <osUser>@<instanceName> (never read, only cleared; null when it fails the account grammar)

keychain.storeSelection: SERVICENOW_TOKEN_STORE unset|''|keychain => KeychainTokenStore (default); 'file' => FileTokenStore; else throws
keychain.cliCleanup: instance remove/update/migrate clear refresh tokens in BOTH the OS keychain and the file store (file store skipped on win32 when its dir is absent)

fileTokenStore.directory: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/happy-platform-mcp, else ~/.config/happy-platform-mcp (note: config-path.js does NOT honour XDG_CONFIG_HOME)
fileTokenStore.fileName: token-<sha256 hex of account> (hashed so case-insensitive filesystems cannot alias keys)
fileTokenStore.modes: directory 0700, files 0600; uid must match; no symlinks (O_NOFOLLOW); nlink <= 1; ancestors trusted; POSIX only (win32 fails closed)
fileTokenStore.write: temp file ".token-<uuid>.tmp" created O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW mode 0600, chmod 0600, then atomic rename

diskWrites.what: instances.json (metadata only once migrated; no secrets)

fix scripts: set_update_set_<fragment>_<ts>.js (SN-Set-Update-Set picker failure), background_script_<ts>.js (SN-Execute-Background-Script trigger failure), <script_name>_<ts>.js (SN-Create-Fix-Script)
diskWrites.mode: mkdir -p; O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW 0600; refuses a symlinked directory

fallbacks.name: SN-Set-Update-Set picker failure => fix script
fallbacks.detail: UI picker /api/now/ui/concoursepicker/updateset; on failure writes a fix script and returns a manual-run message, EXCEPT a "32-character" sys_id validation error which is returned as an error

fallbacks.name: SN-Set-Current-Application
fallbacks.detail: UI picker only; NO fix-script fallback (isError result on failure)

fallbacks.name: SN-Execute-Background-Script
fallbacks.detail: wait:true => /sys.scripts.do; reason NOT_RUN => sys_trigger fallback ONLY if scope is undefined/global; UNKNOWN_OUTCOME => no fallback; wait:false => sys_trigger; trigger failure => fix script

rollback.name: SN-Batch-Create transaction:true
rollback.detail: ONLY STOPS at the first error; it does NOT delete or roll back already-created records, despite the tool description saying "All-or-nothing" (mcp-server-consolidated.js:832-834)

telemetry.default: off; HAPPY_MCP_TELEMETRY on|1|true|yes enables; payload carries tool-name counts only
telemetry.payload: JSON {v:1, package, version, session, transport, node (major), platform, tools{<name>:count}, sent_at}
telemetry.flush: every 10 min or 200 calls, 3 s send timeout
